source_claim: Square Enix's official STAR OCEAN THE SECOND STORY R product page identifies the game as the second installment in the STAR OCEAN series and explicitly names Claude and Rena as its two protagonists.
notes: Only the two protagonists explicitly named by the official title page are included. The larger franchise campaign remains open; this does not infer the other series entries from this one game's cast, and no co-occurrence evidence is used.
